M7 — 2026-10-07
The operator's ~/.claude/settings.json sets SOFAR_WRITEBACK=tool (the stopgap for the rc.2 write-back regression), and every agent shell inherits it. The vitest suite is not hermetic to SOFAR_* variables: with it set, about 27 tests fail on Stop-block and protocol text across hooks, init, wiring-consent and conformance. Run gates with `env -u SOFAR_WRITEBACK npx vitest run` until the setting is removed or the suite strips SOFAR_*.
